status: Silver tables and gold calendar executed in Fabric; source profiling and initial refactored silver build confirmed by user; streamlined build revision awaits validation; analytical gold model remains a design

time_key.rule: Resolve each source independently against the complete chronological UTC timeline; join on UTC, never displayed local time or row number alone
time_key.end_label: Keep source End date for provenance. Derive actual end from UTC start + 60 minutes; raw wall-clock end labels are misleading at DST transitions.

tables.name: dim_generation_source
tables.note: Map the 12 generation columns to stable codes; distinguish pumped-storage output from renewable generation.

tables.name: fact_generation_hour
tables.grain: Hour x country x generation source
tables.null_policy: Retain all 12 source categories, including Nuclear with null values; do not silently replace missing with zero.

semantic_model.relationships: Dimensions filter facts 1-to-many, single direction. No direct fact-to-fact relationships.
semantic_model.geography: Country DE and bidding zone DE-LU remain distinct. First release is fixed to this documented pairing; future countries require an explicit effective-dated country-zone mapping.
semantic_model.date_filters: Use local_date from dim_time_hour for business calendar filtering; UTC for uniqueness and joins.
semantic_model.energy_aggregation: SUM MWh across hours; do not multiply hourly MWh by duration again.
semantic_model.price_aggregation: Time-weighted average across hours; never SUM prices.
semantic_model.weighted_price: SUM(price * grid_load) / SUM(grid_load), with both sums restricted to the same matched valid hours.
semantic_model.hourly_cost_limit: Hourly aggregated prices times hourly energy are an hourly-resolution estimate. They do not reconstruct within-hour price/load covariance or actual settlement costs.

staging_rules: Read UTF-8 BOM and semicolon delimiter; English date labels.
Remove thousands commas, parse decimal point using fixed precision DECIMAL, map '-' to null.
Preserve source file, SHA256, source row number, raw Start date and raw End date.
Keep original row order through DST disambiguation; reject unexpected duplicates, gaps or ordering.
Unpivot generation columns; retain null categories for source fidelity.
Select DE-LU price column explicitly; exclude neighbours average and obsolete DE/AT/LU from project price fact.
Rerun loads by business key without accumulating duplicate rows.
